profile.name: Arjun Dangwal
profile.title: Business Manager | Financial Technology, Market Research
profile.availability: Open to business, sales, strategy, and market research opportunities

summary: Business professional with over 10 years of experience in sales, market research, and supply chain operations, primarily in the FMCG sector. At Santram Industries, I contributed to business ideation, market research, and operational planning, with a focus on consumer-driven product strategies for pasta, cookies, and rusks. Equipped with certifications in market research and research methods, alongside skills in supply chain operations and IT business strategy, I am committed to leveraging analytical capabilities and market insights to align product offerings with customer needs and support organisational growth.
certifications: Designing Blockchain Solutions using Amazon Managed Blockchain

highlights: Led business ideation, market research, and operational planning with a strong focus on the FMCG sector.
Developed consumer-driven product strategies for pasta, vermicelli, cookies, and rusks based on field visits, competitor analysis, and customer surveys.
Aligned product development, pricing decisions, and local market insights to improve demand understanding and grow business opportunities.
Supported strategic growth initiatives by translating market intelligence into actionable operational plans.
Played a key role in business development, sales strategy, and market expansion for a super stockist and consignment forwarding agency.

Managed client relationships and distribution support for leading FMCG brands including Parle Agro Ltd., Campco Ltd., Gillanders Kothari Group, CG Foods, Unibic, Cornitos, and Adarsh Foods & Namkeens.
Supported sales growth through territory planning, visibility strategies, and operational coordination across channels.
Built strong relationships with SME clients to understand financing needs and provide tailored support.
Promoted machinery financing solutions and consistently exceeded sales targets.
Negotiated loan terms that created value for both clients and the organisation.
Collaborated with machinery manufacturers to structure bundled financing options.
Guided clients through the loan application process to ensure smooth and efficient processing.
Supported finance team operations in reporting, day-to-day accounting functions, and tax compliance processes.
Worked with SAP ERP (FI module) to assist with corporate finance operations and statutory compliance.
Gained practical exposure to ERP-based accounting and financial controls in a listed corporate environment.
Assisted in audit and financial record-keeping for the CSD Unit at Raiwala Cantonment, Dehradun.
Developed foundational knowledge in accounting practices within a government-regulated retail environment.
